Better, flag any `href="[^"]*ureq/` in target/doc/sc_agent_http/ (rustdoc prose names the crate 'ureq' without a link, so that is safe). findings.issue: The single secret-read site is enforced by clippy only. An additional `#[expect(clippy::disallowed_methods, reason = ...)]` anywhere is accepted silently. It needs only a reason string, and nothing counts or confines these expects. The claim 'exactly one site' therefore depends on review.
findings.recommendation: Add a cheap mechanical guard. Use an sc-lint source rule or a CI grep that fails when `disallowed_methods` appears in an `expect` attribute (or `ResolvedApiKey::as_str` is called) outside crates/sc-agent-http/src/ureq_transport.rs. Add it to the r-3b gate list.
findings.evidence: This commit has exactly one call site, `key.as_str()` at ureq_transport.rs:169 inside `expose`, with `#[expect]`. Grep for `(key|secret)...as_str()` across crates finds no other ResolvedApiKey reads. The tests, including tests/retry.rs and tests/ureq.rs, use `SecretHeader::matches`. The other `.as_str()` hits are Rev/String/HeaderName. The mechanism holds: clippy.toml `disallowed-methods` is still the mechanism, with no crate-wide allow. Root Cargo.toml denies `allow_attributes` and `allow_attributes_without_reason`, and `--all-targets` clippy covers tests. This is a lint-enforced convention, not a type seal, as ADR-SAG-0020 r-3 admits.
findings.justification_check: justified and retained (the gap is only the missing guard)

findings.issue: `SecretHeader::matches` is a public, ungated, non-constant-time equality oracle for the key. It is implemented in the transport module, not request.rs, to preserve the single `as_str` site. The rustdoc says it is 'for test transports'.
findings.recommendation: Either gate it behind `test-util` (the doctest in request.rs line 136 would then need `# #[cfg(feature = ...)]` or removal), or keep it and accept the oracle, recording that it is intentional in the agent-http.toml notes. The notes do not mention `matches` or `bearer` today. Optionally compare in constant time.
findings.evidence: Only a holder of the SecretHeader (hence the key) can call it, so this is not an active leak. The surface is wider than the 'only UreqTransport touches bytes' story in lib.rs.
findings.justification_check: justified and retained (ADR-SAG-0020 r-3 deviation row records it)
